name: Ricci Factory Direct
old_description: Our staff believes in underpromising and overdelivering. We provide friendly and professional one stop shop service. No job is too large or small. We service the tri state area.
about:
Ricci Factory Direct, a family-owned kitchen and bath showroom, has operated from West Warwick, Rhode Island since 2008. The business was founded as a direct-to-consumer outlet for cabinetry and countertops, emphasizing a low-overhead model that avoids costly advertising.

The company supplies all-wood cabinets with no particle board, along with granite countertops, through a showroom that carries an in-stock Shaker White line deliverable in 14 days and a quick-ship program offering 36 colors in three to five weeks. It sources products from wholesalers that typically deliver within five to six business days, and provides personalized design services seven days a week.

Ricci Factory Direct serves homeowners and trade customers throughout the tri-state area, focusing on residential kitchen and bath remodeling projects. Its one-stop-shop approach covers design consultation, product selection, and delivery coordination.

The company’s stated differentiation rests on a commitment to underpromise and overdeliver, a best-price guarantee that claims up to 50 percent savings over big-box retailers, and a family-operated culture that prioritizes friendly, professional service.
